basis.governing_question: How should Seguros Atlântida redesign the operating model of its five business units and plan the transition to it?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish the current organization, process and cost baseline of the five business units and prioritize the areas to redesign.

gate.label: Go/no-go on design
gate.decision: Go or no-go on designing the target model for the areas prioritized in the diagnostic?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the target operating model for the five business units and a transition plan for each unit.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the final target model and transition plan by unit?

workstreams.name: Claims and underwriting
workstreams.answers: How do claims and underwriting organize their work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview the people who do the work in each unit
Walk through each unit's processes with its staff
Measure workload and cost from operational data

workstreams.name: Sales and customer service
workstreams.answers: How do sales and customer service organize their work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview staff and walk through each unit's processes
Gather customer input on sales and service contacts
Measure workload and cost from operational data

workstreams.name: Finance
workstreams.answers: How does finance organize its work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview the people who do the work in finance
Review finance process documents and cost records
Measure workload and cost from operational data

workstreams.name: Gaps and priority areas
workstreams.answers: Where do cost, workload and performance gaps across the five units matter most for the new model?
activities: Compare cost, workload and performance across the units
Rank the gaps by how much they matter for the new model
Test the ranking with unit heads and their teams

workstreams.name: Target operating model
workstreams.answers: Which target operating model for the five units can the executive committee approve?
activities: Draft model options for structure, roles and governance
Test the options against the diagnostic findings
Prepare the options for the design workshop

workstreams.name: Unit-level design
workstreams.answers: How are structure, roles and governance of the chosen model detailed for each of the five units?
activities: Detail structure, roles and governance with unit leaders
Run unit design rounds, two units at a time
Check each unit design with the people who do the work

workstreams.name: Transition plan by unit
workstreams.answers: What transition plan, by unit, moves each unit from today's operating model to the target?
activities: Sequence each unit's move from today's model to the target
Plan each unit's change two at a time with its leaders
Align the unit plans on timing and dependencies

workstreams.name: Executive committee sign-off
workstreams.answers: What do the executive committee and unit heads need to see to approve the model and transition plans?
activities: Review the model and plans with the executive committee
Collect comments from unit heads and resolve them
Finalize the model and plans for the final readout

deliverables.name: Claims and underwriting work, process and cost baseline
Sales and customer service work, process and cost baseline
Finance work, process and cost baseline
Diagnostic readout with prioritized redesign areas
Target operating model options for the five units
Unit-level design of structure, roles and governance
Approval pack: target operating model and transition plans

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the diagnostic and secure data access
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Do the unit heads give access to the data and people the baselines need?
agenda: Present the diagnostic approach and the unit baselines
Align on the data and people each baseline needs
Confirm data and people access for the claims and underwriting baseline

events.label: Workshop 1: first baselines
events.purpose: Review first baselines and set gap focus
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Which gaps in the first two baselines should the prioritization cover first?
agenda: Present the claims, underwriting, sales and customer service baselines
Discuss the gaps visible so far across the two baselines
Decide which gaps the prioritization covers first

events.label: Go/no-go on design
events.purpose: Decide whether to move into design
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Go or no-go on designing the target model for the areas prioritized in the diagnostic?
agenda: Review the finance work, process and cost baseline
Present the diagnostic readout and prioritized redesign areas
Decide whether to design the target model for the prioritized areas

events.label: Workshop 2: model options
events.purpose: Review model options for the five units
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Which target operating model option goes forward into unit-level design?
agenda: Present the target operating model options for the five units
Discuss how the options differ across the five units
Decide which option goes forward into unit-level design

events.label: Workshop 3: unit designs
events.purpose: Review unit designs before the final gate
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Go or no-go on building the transition plan by unit on these unit-level designs?
agenda: Present the unit-level design of structure, roles and governance
Review how the designs fit together across the five units
Decide whether to build the transition plan by unit on these designs

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Approve the model and transition plans
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Approve the final target model and transition plan by unit?
agenda: Present the approval pack: target model and transition plans
Review the transition plan by unit and the open points
Decide on approval of the target model and transition plans

architect_notes: Engagement length is estimated at 25 to 29 weeks; slower unit rounds, target-model design and unit transition plans would push it toward 32.
Public research lists Lisbon, Porto and 12 regional offices; confirm whether offices are in the Diagnostic, which would add a site driver and weeks.
No Implementation phase: the engagement type is assessment, so the transition is planned inside Design, not executed.
No Handover phase: the executive committee receives the result at the Design gate; add one if each unit head must receive a plan separately.
The executive committee's approval is a success criterion, but it is not among the stakeholders; confirm its seat at the final readout.

sub_questions.question: How do the five business units organize their work, processes and costs today?
Where do cost, workload and performance gaps in the five units matter most for the new model?
Which target operating model for the five units can the executive committee approve?
How are structure, roles and governance of the chosen model detailed for each of the five units?
What transition plan, by unit, moves each unit from today's operating model to the target?

drivers.evidence: all five business units (claims, underwriting, sales, customer service and finance)

phases.name: Diagnostic

work.unit: Unit diagnosed (interviews, process walk-throughs, workload and cost baseline)

phases.why: Five units diagnosed two at a time in three rounds; above the typical 4 to 8 weeks because all five units are covered.

phases.name: Design

work.unit: Target model for the whole organization (structure, roles, governance)
Unit-level design detailed with the unit's leaders
Transition plan for one business unit, sequenced with the others

phases.why: Whole-model design, then unit designs and unit transition plans, each two at a time, and one sign-off cycle; above typical 6 to 10 weeks.

sizing.levers: Run three units at once instead of two, or diagnose three representative units and extend to the other two from data.
